collapseWhitespaceRuns.description: Collapse runs of spaces and tabs to one space, tabs to spaces, and three or more newlines to one blank line. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

normalizeTypography.description: Map typographic variants (curly quotes, dashes, ellipsis) to plain ASCII. Fixed on: only true is accepted.

collapsePunctuationRuns.description: Collapse repeated punctuation such as !!! or ??? to one mark. Fixed on: only true is accepted.
